tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang la 'jigs byed skor gyi bka' 'dri zhus tho dang dris lan bzhugs so// lags tshar chen gyi yig thog nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sgrub mchod brgya tshar grangs gsog dbu tshugs tsam lags par/ cung zad dogs pa'i gnas bsham gyi skabs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod gsungs kyang 'don char drag mchod pa yod pas de bzhin bshams na 'thus min dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs phyogs skyong so so'i ming mtha'i ya la dpe rnams su 'greng bu yod med sna tshogs 'dug kyang tshar chen gyi phyag drag can na 'greng bu mchis pas de bzhin 'thad min dang / dbyangs bcu gsal byed ha la drangs pa 'di tshar lugs kho na'i khyad lags sam ji 'dra dang / 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas rnams zhes pa chad skyon yin zhes ngag dbang chos grags kyis gsung bas 'jug dgos min dang / gnas yo byin rlabs kyi skabs mchod pa so so'i sngags 'di rnams don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba de 'dra yang / tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs su gsungs pa dang tshig zur cung zad ma mthun zhing chad lhag yod 'dra la gang 'thad dang / tshogs zhing mchod pa'i skabs su lha mo rnams kyi sku mdog 'di tshar chen gyis dpa' gcig sgrub thabs su 'don char gsung zhing / lhan thabs su sgeg mo'i sngags kyi gzhug tu phreng ba ma mthud nas 'don mi dgos 'dra ba ji 'dra dang / bsrung 'khor gyi sngags 'di la yi ge ma dag pa'i rgyun 'byams 'dra bas mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi phyag bris ngo ma nas drung yig zhing gshegs dpe bshus pa zur gsal 'di ljags bzlas gnang ba dang mthun min dang / phreng ba byin rlabs rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa de ma rnyed pas phran rang nas tshar chen gyi gsung la dpag zhal las khong dpa' gcig sgrub thabs kyi de dang / lha las bum bzhin bskyed/

skye mched byin rlabs dang / ye shes pa 'dren bstim byas/ dbang bskur man dpa' gcig sgrub thabs su gsungs pa sor bzhag zhus pas 'thus min dang / bzlas pa bsdu ba'i 'dod gsol dpa' gcig sgrub thabs nang bzhin zhus pas 'thus min dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ngag dbang chos grags kyis dpyad pa zhig mdzad nas snod gzhal yas khang la bsdu skabs bsrung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang rnams bsdu/ bcud 'khor gyi lha la bsdu/ de rnams yum la bsdu/ de gtso bo la bsdu/ de ye shes sems dpa' dang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la bsdus nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la gzhag pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / rang gis go tshod bsdu tshul de srod thun gyi skabs su yin nam snyam zhing / sgrub mchod skabs lam dus nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin byas/ bsrung 'khor gyi lha rnams yum la bstim/ yab kyi zhal phyag zhabs lhag ma gdan dang bcas pa rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la bstim nas 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas dgos sam snyam pa'i lugs 'di ni dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bcu gsum pa'i sgrub dkyil du gsungs pas ji ltar lags dang / drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma la zan leb gras nas rtsig pa dang / zlum po mtheb skyu can 'dam gar gsungs pa'i zan gras 'di lcags mkhar dngos gnas yin nam snyam pas ji 'dra dang / dngos sta mdun bskyed kyi skabs bskyed chog sgrub thabs bzhin bya gsungs par dga' ba gsum gyi skabs su zhes pa rnams 'dus de la phog pa'i rkyen gyis zhes dang / spyan drangs de la phog pa'i rkyen gyis zhes pa'i tshig bsgyur dgos 'dra ba ji 'dra dang / sgrub thabs dkyil nag 'gros ma rta ra ba'i zhal slob gcig gis mdzad dam snyam pas yi ge na sta gon gyi skabs bstod pa sngon la btang bdud rtsi phul rjes snyan gsan dbab rgyas btab dang mchod bstod thams cad la nga rgyal bzung ba'i sngags sbyar ba zhig 'dug kyang /

tshar chen rin po che'i lhan thabs na bstod pa'i rjes la snyan gsan dbab/ mchod bstod rnams las la bzung ba'i sngags med 'dra na ji 'dra zhu dgos dang / bum bskyed dang mjug chog gi mchod pa'i skabs nag 'gros ma na rol mo'i rjes su 'dod yon lnga'i sngags bshad/ lhan thabs na rol mo'i rjes su yid byung gi mchod pa gsungs pas ji 'dra dang / sgrub mchod skabs las gshin bcu gsum ma la gtor ma phul na 'thus min dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal gzigs phyogs rwa 'khrid sngon 'gro'i dbang gnang skabs gtso bo'i mdun ser sna gshin rje gshed dang / zhal gti mug gshed po la gzigs pa yin gsungs pa zhig nges 'dug kyang / ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'di skor mkhas grub mang po la dogs slong mdzad mthar sgrub dkyil la gong bzhin dang / bdag 'jug la gti mug gshed po la mdun lta bar gsungs pas dpe na phrag dog gshed po la zhal gzigs dgos pas dag bya dag byed cung ma 'grig pas zhal gzigs phyogs ci yin dang / mkhan chen gyi gsung 'di la dpag na bdag bum gnyis la mdun lhor bstan/ mdun bskyed la shar bstan yin 'dra bas/ kha nang du bskyed skabs kyang de rtsis kyi phyogs ma 'dzol ba zhig dgos sam snyam pas 'di skor tshang mar dogs sel gyi bka' gsal mkhyen/ ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad rwa lugs kyi skor bka' 'dri phebs pa na ning phyis gzugs gcong gis zin pa nas bzung don gnyis gang yang sgrub mi nus shing dbang lung 'phral mkho kha shas byed thub rigs kyang ngos 'dzin g.yar khral lta bu las zhib dpyad ma nus pa dang / da lam kyang 'phral mar dpe lta ba sogs ma nus shing / blo ngan brjed ngas che bas thugs dogs sel nus 'bul rgyu ma mchis kyang / sngon ma sku zhabs su chos bka' 'bul skabs rang la bsnyen sgrub nyams myong gi byin nus ma mchis pa dang / phra zhib dpyad nus kyi blo nus med tsam las dbang khrid lung rjes gnang gang sar gang shes gang nus kyis rang gis gang thob brtson pa chen pos phul ba bzhin/

sku zhabs nyid nas dpyad brdar zhib gzigs gnang ba las lhag pa'i gsung rgyun yid la zin pa dang / lung rig tshad mas sgrub pa'i 'di gsal 'bul rgyu ma mchis lags/ phyi rol drug cu pa rwa lo'i dbang chog chen mor cho ga tshar rjes rol mo go mtshon bcas phyi rol du gtor bzlog lta bu byed spro na byas chog phul yod bsam zhing / 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse yang nub re bzhin drug cu pa gnang tshul dang / de nyid kyi slob dpon mnga' ris bla chen gyis kyang nub res kyi gtor ma 'phang ba'i las sbyor rtags thon gnang tshul la dpyad na sgrub mchod dang zhar sgrub lta bu gtor ma yang zan gras lcags mkhar lta bu drag po gtso cher bzo ba sogs/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang dang / sngags 'chang rta ra ba chen po'i drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog nang gsal gtor bzlog gtsor sgrub lta bu'i dgos chos phran rnams dor ba'i thun gtor 'phen pa lta bu'i spros pa 'bring po zhig bka' drin bskyangs par 'gal ba gang med lags/ da ltar drug cu pa'i don tshang ba'i spros pa chung ba'i zhi ba gtso che ba'i dbang gis gtor ma zlum po mtheb skyu dang sngags grangs can 'di kha sgrub mchod rigs dang / dbang sgrub rigs la 'di las mi mdzad 'dug de bzhin mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi bcas bsham bum pa 'jog tshul sogs tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang mdzad pa las/ rgyas pa rwa lo'i dbang chog chen mor gsal ba ltar de nang bzhin gnang ba da ltar de'i bka' lung yod bzhin la phyag len gnang ba shin tu legs pa las 'gal ba ci la yod lags/ mchod sngags dang phyogs skyong gi sngags sogs gang ci'i dpe dag mthun pa shin tu dkon zhing / dag min sgra rig la go ba legs chags zhig gis spyir dpyad pa dang / bye brag gong ma'i gsung rgyun gnyis go bstun rang gal che/ yang de rigs dka' zhing phran nas kyang sde dger dbang brgya tshar 'bul skabs rwa pod yig rnying rnams la lta khul byas kyang /

don yod rdo rje'i de rang phyogs 'dra ba las go don mtha' chod ma byung zhing / phyis kyi sgra pa rnams ham che nga rgyal can gyi gsung rab la yang rang dbang bsgyur ches pas de la yang yid gtod mi nus 'dug phran la sgra rig gi phyogs ston lta bu'i slob dpon karma dpal grub dang / drung yig chen mo sogs gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu gzigs pa'i mtha' rgya chod na nges par mdzad pa ma gtogs thugs shin tu mdzangs pa bcas yid ches kyi yul bla na med pa yin kyang / da cha nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bur lags/ drung yig chen mo'i gsung rgyun la sgra rig nang nas ka lā pa 'di rang mang nyung ran pa gsal ba legs shing / 'grel pa zhwa lu pa'i 'di rang gsang sngags cho ga la phan thogs che ba yong zhes thugs rtsis gnang 'dug pas/ de rigs la yang thugs gzhibs gnang ba gal che zhing / dpang los zhu dag gnang ba'i rgyang rtse gzungs 'bum kyang phal cher yid ches pa dag pa yod 'gro bas de la cho ga'i sngags mchod sngags e yod bsam lags/ cho ga'i ngag 'don kyang tshig rigs gong 'og 'dra la mi 'dra 'don shin tu dka' ba sogs/ sa lugs kyai rdor lta bu'i 'don bde zhig mi 'dug kyang / bdag gi bla ma yab sras yan chod grub brnyes sha stag gi byin rlabs tshan kha mngon gyur gzhan dang mi 'dra ba bcas/ sku zhabs nyid nas mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi dri ba dris lan/ rwa pod yig rnying la thugs gzhibs dpyad pa'i zin bris dang / cho ga nag 'gros 'don bde the tshom med pa zhig bka' drin bskyangs thub na shin tu legs par yong 'dug cing / phreng ba byin rlabs dang bzlas dmigs rgyas pa dpa' gcig sgrub thabs tshar chen gsung ltar la tshig ris rgyas bsdus la 'gal ba mi 'dug cing ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs nas phyogs mthun byung na tshig gi legs cha bzhes par 'gal ba mi 'dug cing / rwa lugs tshang ma rang la rwa lo chen po'i gsung sgrub thabs lnga dang dbang dkyil bka' 'grel sogs dang /

tshar chen gyi lhan thabs sgrub thabs/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yab sras rnams kyi cho ga sbyin sreg gtor bzlog rnams na gang gsal rang go bstun gnang na legs lags// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang la 'jigs byed skor gyi bka' 'dri zhus tho dang dris lan/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
